geography.heading: All of Uzbekistan, from a single advisory partner

panel.hint: Tap a region, or hover and pause on it.

hero.title: Tax, legal and accounting advisory in Uzbekistan
hero.lede: One team for companies entering and operating in Uzbekistan: tax, law, accounting, HR and funding, coordinated by a single partner. In English, Russian or Uzbek.

services.title: Every discipline, one point of contact
services.lede: Most firms hand you a lawyer, an accountant and a tax adviser who never speak. We run them as one team, so the structure that saves you tax also survives a legal review.

tax.title: Tax consulting
tax.text: Planning, compliance and structuring for foreign-owned companies, holdings and cross-border operations. We tell you which regime and incentives apply to your structure.

legal.title: Legal advisory
legal.text: Company formation, contracts, governance and regulatory compliance under Uzbek law.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.text: Bookkeeping, reporting and statutory filings, in IFRS and Uzbek standards.

hr.title: HR and payroll
hr.text: Payroll, labour contracts and contributions for local and expatriate staff.

funding.title: Funding and M&A
funding.text: IFI programmes, grants, due diligence and deal structuring.

operations.title: Operations
operations.text: Entity management, Employer of Record, corporate services and a virtual office.

track.title: Work our advisers have led
track.lede: From a nuclear power plant budget to Islamic finance law: six of the fifteen engagements on record.
track.foot: Engagements led by Advizen advisers. Client names withheld.

regions.title: All fourteen regions, one adviser
regions.lede: Free economic zones, regional incentives and registration practice differ by region. Pick one to see where it fits your plans.

insights.title: Read before you invest
insights.lede: Plain-language briefings on Uzbek tax, law and regulation, written by the advisers who do the work.
insights.guideText: Market entry, regulation and day-to-day operations in one guide for foreign investors.
